wards.attribution: H3 analysis zones (res 6) — NCR has no single ward dataset across its 19 municipalities

population.source: Census of India 2011 — NCR core municipalities (Delhi + Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Gautam Buddh Nagar, Sonipat, Baghpat, Palwal fringes within the peripheral ring)
population.method: city total split equally across analysis zones. H3 zones are equal-area, so equal split is area-consistent. An NCR-core ESTIMATE, not a per-zone Census count.
